messages.subject: Harrow v Melbourne Sealtech - Particulars of Claim, my mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

My marked-up Particulars are attached. Main changes: I've strengthened the causation plea to make clear a number of failures occurred well under 1,500 hours, added a short paragraph pleading the systemic manufacturing inference, and tidied the flatness wording. Content and figures otherwise as your draft. Happy to finalise once you've taken client instructions on the statement of truth.

Nathaniel
